truckFeatures.refusal: rev1 (revolve): the sketch is exactly the default 40 by 25 rectangle at the corner (an undrawn sketch looks the same), so the spin is not built; draw your outline, for example with rect(10, 30, { at: [15, 15] }), or move this rectangle by a fraction of a millimetre if it is the one you want.
